sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Rajendra Kumar Singh,Nitin Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Mahendra Pratap Singh,Vijay Gopal Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
By means of the the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No. 281 of 2023 at Police Station-Chandpur, District-Bijnor under Sections 498A, 304-B, 328 I.P.C.
and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The applicant is in jail since 28.04.2023.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 04.07.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Rajendra Kumar Singh, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Vijay Gopal, learned counsel on behalf of informant and Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA-I from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
Israil vs State Of U.P. on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171798200/
1
1. The applicant and the deceased had cordial relations.
The applicant has been nominated only to extract money.
2. The applicant is the husband of the deceased.
The deceased went to her parental house to celebrate the Eid festival in the evening of 22.04.2023.

She and the partook some eatables as part of the rituals.
3. When the deceased started showing signs of physical discomfort on 23.04.2023,
the applicant and parents of the deceased promptly rushed her to the hospital for providing medical aid.
4. The deceased died in the evening of 24.04.2023 while undergoing medical treatment.

5. The first informant in his statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. has repudiated the prosecution case set out in the F.I.R.
6.
The applicant did not administer any poison to the deceased.
7. Prosecution evidence does not connect the applicant with the offence.
8. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from the instant case.
9. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of her influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant- Israil be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
( ii )
The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
Order Date :- 19.9.2023

Jaswant  Israil vs State Of U.P. on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171798200/
